name: UNIX Seventh Edition on PDP-11-class systems

technical_context.logical_address_space: model/MMU-dependent PDP-11 virtual and physical addressing; no single model is canonical to this profile
storage_model: disk/tape/device configurations supported by the selected PDP-11 host and UNIX kernel configuration
display_hardware: terminal-oriented; no single raster display is intrinsic
audio_hardware: not intrinsic to the UNIX V7 operating environment
technical_context.executable_or_load_model: a.out-family executable context and kernel-mediated process execution
technical_context.filesystem: UNIX filesystem hierarchy and inode/file-descriptor model
technical_context.boot_process: machine-specific bootstrap and configured kernel/device environment; exact path depends on the selected PDP-11 model/storage
programming_environment: standard UNIX tools documented for V7
timing_constraints: scheduler/device timing and hardware performance depend on PDP-11 model and peripheral configuration
technical_context.rom_or_os_assumptions: UNIX distribution binaries and media images are not embedded; networking is not assumed to be an intrinsic universal property of every V7 installation.

hardware_fact: PDP-11-class processors are 16-bit little-endian systems, with model-dependent memory/MMU features
documented_software_behaviour: UNIX V7 exposes process, file, shell and a.out-era programming conventions documented in the manual
reconstruction_inference: A minimum reconstruction can model shell-to-process-to-device flow without claiming one canonical PDP-11 configuration.
unknown: exact PDP-11 model, memory size, controller set and peripheral inventory unless separately specified

emulator_or_reimplementation.limitations: No emulator or reimplementation result is canonical evidence in the PR #4 seed.

recovery_equivalence.reason: Profile preserves public technical context and reconstruction boundaries without embedding the original proprietary system bytes.

scope_notes.reason: UNIX V7 ran on PDP-11-class configurations; this profile preserves the software environment plus host-family constraints without inventing one canonical physical machine.
